column3: With respect to the Mall at Prince George's Mortgage Loan (9.4%), the fourth largest tenant, Primark, leasing approximately 5.0% of the net rentable area at the related Mortgaged Property, has executed a lease but is not yet open for business pending the completion of the build-out of its related space. Primark is required to open for business by May 18, 2026 and has a rent credit against the base rent payable under its lease through May 17, 2026. We cannot assure you that Primark will open for business or commence paying rent on its space as anticipated or at all.
